# endpointcentral Provider

Manage ManageEngine Endpoint Central Cloud through its REST API.

The provider signs in with Zoho OAuth 2.0: it holds a refresh token of a **Self Client** created in the Zoho API console of your region and exchanges it for short-lived access tokens. Every argument can also be set with an `ENDPOINTCENTRAL_*` environment variable; an argument in the configuration takes precedence.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    endpointcentral = {
      source = "dasslk/endpointcentral"
    }
  }
}

# Credentials usually come from the environment, e.g. through 1Password:
#   ENDPOINTCENTRAL_CLIENT_ID, ENDPOINTCENTRAL_CLIENT_SECRET, ENDPOINTCENTRAL_REFRESH_TOKEN
provider "endpointcentral" {
  region = "eu" # us, eu, in, au, cn, jp, ca, uk or sa: the ending of your console's domain
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `access_token` (String, Sensitive) An access token to use as is, instead of `client_id`, `client_secret` and `refresh_token`. Access tokens expire after an hour, so this suits short tests. Environment variable `ENDPOINTCENTRAL_ACCESS_TOKEN`.
- `client_id` (String) Client ID of the Self Client. Environment variable `ENDPOINTCENTRAL_CLIENT_ID`.
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) Client secret of the Self Client. Environment variable `ENDPOINTCENTRAL_CLIENT_SECRET`.
- `endpoints` (Attributes) Override the hosts `region` selects, e.g. for a proxy or a test server. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--endpoints))
- `max_retries` (Number) How often a request is retried after throttling (HTTP 429), a server error or a network failure, with exponential backoff. Default 4; `0` disables retries. Environment variable `ENDPOINTCENTRAL_MAX_RETRIES`.
- `refresh_token` (String, Sensitive) Refresh token issued to the Self Client. Environment variable `ENDPOINTCENTRAL_REFRESH_TOKEN`.
- `region` (String) Region of the tenant: `us` (default), `eu`, `in`, `au`, `cn`, `jp`, `ca`, `uk` or `sa`, the domain ending of the console URL you sign in to. It selects the API and accounts hosts. Environment variable `ENDPOINTCENTRAL_REGION`.
- `skip_credentials_validation` (Boolean) Skip obtaining an access token while the provider is configured. By default bad credentials fail right away, with Zoho's reason, instead of at the first API call.

<a id="nestedatt--endpoints"></a>
### Nested Schema for `endpoints`

Optional:

- `accounts` (String) Zoho accounts URL that issues access tokens. Environment variable `ENDPOINTCENTRAL_ENDPOINT_URL_ACCOUNTS`.
- `api` (String) Endpoint Central API base URL. Environment variable `ENDPOINTCENTRAL_ENDPOINT_URL_API`.
- `mdm` (String) MDM API base URL, used by the Mac profile and MDM group resources, e.g. `https://mdm.manageengine.eu`. Environment variable `ENDPOINTCENTRAL_ENDPOINT_URL_MDM`.
